title: Loyalty spend check
claim: Loyalty members spend more than twice as much per visit as other customers.
brief: Marketing wants this on a board slide on Friday: members spend 2.4x per visit. Check it first.
dictionary:
# Data dictionary

- **visits.spend**: basket total in US dollars, tax included.
- **customers.loyalty_member**: 1 if the customer is in the loyalty program.
- **stores.pos_version**: point-of-sale software that exported the visit.
